pr.body:
Private training work now has confirmed lifecycle actions, immutable program history, explicit actual units, recoverable guided setup/memory and dated local Coach decisions. Latest valid saved decisions survive cold start and offer the correct continuation; a newer Keep plan suppresses the older action. SQLite connection ownership and stale-result guards protect initialization and recovery. Core training remains guest-only, local and deterministic, with the qualified public-content gate preserved.

The Coach date editor now starts with a compact explicit window. Android keyboard overlap adds measured scroll space so edited fields remain visible after review evidence disappears. Optional local voice entry falls back honestly when its offline model is absent, validates typed corrections, and changes only the unsaved draft after explicit review/application. Clearing the correction text keeps its editor open and disables Review; backgrounding clears unconfirmed previews.

Validation:

- Latest app source **3f1752ed**: full `npm run verify` exit 0, **1,202 tests / 144 suites**, Doctor 21/21, security/vendor/config/audit checks and both mobile exports. Standalone native x86_64 guest build/install passed. Published head e440b48d adds documentation/evidence only.
- Pixel 7 emulator, Android 16/API36, WHPX/host GPU: focused edited time-zone field remains fully visible above the keyboard at normal and 200% text. Invalid-zone guidance and valid reread pass. The preceding de0711b0 and 057d5936 failures remain documented, including correct focus/value assertions.
- Voice source 057d5936: native clear/retype/background-reset retest passes. Earlier typed review/application changes one unsaved duration25→26/RPE blank→7 and autosave timestamps, preserving every actual completed set/session. Successful speech recognition is blocked because the offline model is missing; this is not spoken-transcript acceptance.
- Final external receiver JSON has **1,082 records**, all 36 arrays identical to the preceding voice retest. Fixture preparation separately added two explicit lifecycle events; no silent cycle switch or achieved-set creation occurred. Route/dump interruptions around activity/font recreation are retained separately.
- Dated earlier binaries observed cold Coach receipt recovery, confirmed Keep plan, recreation stress, atomic handover, deferred baseline/no-new-goal behavior, deletion and exact native restore/re-export. These scenarios are bound to their stated binary and were not all rerun on 3f1752ed.
- Remote CI at older **a63a3b74** completed Android compilation/proof and unsigned iOS simulator compilation, payload binding, installation/cold launch. Quality38534108570 passed; superseded38534099956 was cancelled during Jest. These receipts do not cover the newer fixes or full iOS journeys. New-head CI is pending its own terminal proof.

[Coach native QA, screenshots and exact launch instructions](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e440b48d/docs/50_LOCAL_COACH_REVIEW_QA.md) · [Voice native QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e440b48d/docs/51_LOCAL_VOICE_NATIVE_QA.md) · [Atomic handover QA](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e440b48d/docs/47_ATOMIC_HANDOVER_QA.md) · [Reconciled TODO](https://github.com/camster91/Shift6/blob/e440b48d/docs/43_SHIPPING_GOAL_AND_TODO.md)

All **54 open issues** remain mapped and open. Provisional engineering score stays **53/100** under doc34; human acceptance is unverified. Deliberately induced native database failure/warm retry, complete repeat-week runtime, successful recognition, current physical Android/iOS journeys, assistive technology, qualified public content, signing/support and store acceptance remain pending. Disabled Gemini preparation is separate PR350. This draft is stacked on #349; no merge, deployment, paid activation, store submission or issue closure is included.
